AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Trusted administrator account record granted full control over license accounts and system management.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

LicenseAccount.title: LicenseAccount
LicenseAccount.description: Activated student or admin license account (99,999 IDs per grade, 1-year validity, real-time single active session anti-sharing).

accountId.description: Normalized account ID (e.g., l1_00001..l9_99999, l1_001..l9_999, or uyenlp1310).

grade.description: Authorized grade level (1..9 for student licenses, 0 for all-grade admin license).

isAdminAccount.description: Whether this license carries admin privileges. Cannot be set to true by non-admins.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID currently holding the active session on this license.

ownerName.description: Student display name entered on the active device.

activeSessionId.description: Unique active session token; changing this kicks previous devices out in real-time.

deviceLabel.description: Browser and OS label of the currently active device.

status.description: License status. Revoked licenses are locked and cannot be reactivated or taken over by students.

activatedAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the license was first activated.

expiresAt.description: Expiration timestamp (1 year from activation). Immutable by non-admins.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest session takeover or admin update.

loginCount.description: Monotonic counter tracking total activations and device takeovers.

/admins/{uid}.description: Registry of trusted admin UIDs (bootstrapped admin email junvu1707@gmail.com can manage).

/licenses/{accountId}.description: Real-time license activation, 1-year expiration, and single-active-session tracking per account ID.
